members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2666: Race condition in `post_writer`: the task group spawns `post_writer` (via `tg.start_soon`) and the caller proceeds to send the first request immediately, before `post_writer`'s `write_stream_reader` context is actually entered/ready — so an early message can be lost or the client can hang waiting on it. Both PRs fix this the identical way: add an anyio `task_status: TaskStatus[None] = anyio.TASK_STATUS_IGNORED` parameter to `post_writer` and call `task_status.started(None)` right after entering the stream context, so the spawn site can `tg.start(...)` and block until `post_writer` is actually ready.

(2 PRs)
